title: FileContent
description: Metadata of one file at the review commit. Bytes come from rawUrl. For a browser repository the server reads no file content: binary, renderable, lineCount, symlinkTarget, and rawUrl are null, and the client reads the blob blobSha from GitHub.

language.description: Highlighting language by file name, for example php, javascript, or markdown. Open set.

binary.description: NUL byte in the first 8000 bytes. Null for browser.

renderable.description: type = file, not binary, not tooLarge. Null for browser.

lineCount.description: Null when not renderable, and for browser.

rawUrl.description: V8 of the file. Null for browser.
